about: NEUTRALIZE that does not contain, and ISOLATE as it is read back (external audit CMB-002; lab PR 217): a /var/tmp miner (StagingExec, ENGAGED) whose worker is in an uninterruptible wait is refused a write to the agent's state (COMBAT locked). At the INVESTIGATE deadline the kill cgroup takes the tree but the worker is still running after the kill: the tree is NOT contained, and the ladder isolates (allowed: COMBAT is locked), evidence first. The first attempt leaves IPv4 not isolated (read back): signed, retried 5 s later; the second isolates IPv4 with IPv6 unavailable on this host (a hole, signed as one). A signed unlock stands the ladder down and lifts the isolation (IPv4 cleared, IPv6 unavailable): ALERTED.
